title: Semantic Discovery Engine and Compact Experience Results
summary: Introduces relevance-ranked discovery, multi-purpose restaurant metadata and compact results while keeping the optional manual day board.
changes: Adds a generic semantic Discovery Engine that ranks direct matches above contextual suggestions
Models restaurants with multiple meal moments instead of one fixed category
Separates primary beach results from restaurants and other nearby suggestions
Redesigns results as compact rows so five options are visible without excessive scrolling
Adds free search, clear search, category filters and expandable result groups
Keeps drag-and-drop, free-text planning, local persistence and sharing
Records discovery and plan signals without presenting invented popularity claims
test: Confirm v2026.07.24.270 appears on desktop and mobile
Search for strand and confirm beaches and pool are shown before restaurants near the beach
Search for morgenmad and confirm Restaurant Cerros del Águila and Hoyo 19 are available
Open Spisning and confirm Restaurant Cerros del Águila is not locked to breakfast
Confirm at least five compact results can be scanned without large cards
Test expand and collapse where more than five results exist
Add results to Min dag, reorder them and add a custom free-text item
Reload and confirm the manual plan is retained
